title: MKA/MACsec: Implement XPN Cipher Suites
description:
Implement the XPN Cipher Suites (except for full recovery of the 64-bit
packet number). This requires saving additional information from MKA
such as the salt.  For MKA version 3, use the ordering of the MIs to
determine the SSCI mapping. For earlier versions, sort using the SCIs
if we know all of them. In other cases, try all the possible SSCIs for
a SA. Handle both the cases where, in compliance with the spec, the Live
Peer List appears after the Distributed SAK parameter set, and the
apparently common implementation where all the parameter sets are
ordered in ascending order of type (and thus the Live Peer List appears
before the Distributed SAK.)

Only create the SAK info on the first pass in MKA. On later passes, just
retrieve it.

Update the Algorithm Agility value string. The essential algorithm parameters
did not change between IEEE 802.1X-2010 and -2020, so the meaning of the value
was simply updated.

Support captures where the same CKN has multiple SAKs with the same AN
over the lifetime of the capture (due to rekeying).

Display the SCI system identifier (MAC address) and port identifier
components in MKA as already done in MACsec.

AI-Assisted: no

Yes, it doesn't need to be in both places.
We're missing out on the 'incorrect value' here. Do we want that in?

According to the spec, when the default cipher suite is used, the 64-bit value should never actually be in the packet but is implicit. In the dissector the corrected value for the default suite is set in the struct if an explicit value isn't present (even on V1 where the spec had the wrong value), so the incorrect value should never be necessary.

To be more precise, the incorrect value will appear in the announcement parameter set with the "MACsec Cipher Suites TLV" that details what is supported for MKA negotiation, but it will not appear in the Distributed SAK parameter set, and the latter is the only thing that needs to be shared with MACsec.
